dedupe_keys.name: geospm geographic information portal of saint pierre et miquelon catalogue map library viewer

description: GéoSPM is the geographic information portal of Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon, the French overseas collectivity south of Newfoundland. The home page read on 2026-09-28 offers a catalogue where users can freely build their own maps from the data of interest, a map library (cartothèque) of ready maps, and a viewer to search and display thematic data, with membership and registration for partners; news items cover the hunting and wildlife reserves created in 1992 and 1993 and the evolution of the coastline of the islands, and it links to the IGN Géoportail, the collectivity and the prefecture. Coverage is the archipelago. Access is free for consultation; no licence is stated on the home page, and downloads may depend on membership. Caveats: the layer list was not read, and infrastructure layers (roads, networks, buildings) are not confirmed. It supports coastal hazard exposure and adaptation studies of the islands' roads, port and settlements, for example from shoreline change data. No related Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon record is catalogued; the IGN national portal complements it.
licence: not stated on the home page
